title: Commensurability Relations Between Deligne-Mostow-Thurston and Ghazouani-Pirio Monodromy Groups
summary: We classify commensurability relations between Deligne--Mostow--Thurston monodromy groups and the sixteen arithmetic Ghazouani--Pirio monodromy groups arising from moduli of flat cone metrics on the sphere and on the torus. In both settings, the monodromy group preserves a skew-Hermitian form coming from twisted homology. We use a degeneration method to compute their determinant classes in the genus one case.
